answer: A trolley bag can be at most 55 x 40 x 23 cm (wheels may add up to 5 cm) and 10 kg, so a 55 x 40 x 23 cm suitcase fits the rule.

answer: Besides your bag you may take for free: a coat or blanket, a mobile phone, reading material, duty-free items bought airside after security, infant food and a foldable stroller/crib for infants, and a pair of crutches for disabled passengers. answer: Do not pack cash, securities, jewellery, precious metals/stones, electronics (laptops, cameras, phones), documents, ID, keys, liquids, medicine, art or perishables in checked bags; Wizz Air is not liable for their loss, damage or delay.
